newsitem.title: USA: Rock-Tenn says to buy Davey Co for stock.
newsitem.headline: Rock-Tenn says to buy Davey Co for stock.

text.p: Rock-Tenn Co said on Monday that it had entered into a definitive agreement to acquire substantially all of the assets and assume some liabilities of Davey Co.

The purchase price for the acquisition will consist of about 865,000 shares of Rock-Tenn's class A common stock, Rock-Tenn said in a statement. It added that it expects the transaction to occur in mid-summer.
Rock-Tenn added that Davey's Downingtown facility would be closed before the closing date of the transaction.
The privately owned Davey Co manufactures recyled paperboard used by the book industry for hard-bound covers. It had annual sales of about $25 million in 1996, Rock-Tenn said.
Rock-Tenn is a packaging company that makes recycled paperboard and paperboard products.
